card.name: Inch marks after fractions and numerals
card.fires_on: Mostly the inch mark (") or unit word right after a fraction or number such as 1/8 or 1/4, mainly in drill or craft instructions. Also fires on digits inside numbers like 14 or 145 and partway through some names.

modes.label: Inch mark after fraction
modes.description: A quote mark or inch unit directly after a fraction giving a size.

modes.label: Inside numbers and durations
modes.description: A digit or time unit within a number, such as a verse number or a span of days or years.

modes.label: Inside product names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or drug name.

card.plain: It marks the spot right after a measurement number, like a fraction of an inch in drilling steps.
